title: profile.sh --live

source._comment: 'image' is the original; build.py runs it through dotify into 'file'. Drop 'image' to fall back to the monogram cache.
source._field_help: Minimum ink in every cell, 0 for none. Gives the panel its lit-matrix background.

dotify._invert_help: true = ink where the photo is DARK. Right for a dark-haired subject on a pale wall; it also keeps the wall out of the panel for free.
dotify._crop_help: left,top,right,bottom as fractions, framing the head between the window blind and the monitor. Its aspect must match cols:rows.
dotify._shape_help: 48x64 is the point where glasses and eyes survive the reduction; 34x46 only gave a silhouette.
dotify._vignette_help: Fades ink toward the edges so the room falls away and the face is what is lit.
